closure_target: complete grant and funding-recipient condition, certification, review, withholding, termination, continuation, appeal, correction, and no-action roster
coverage_statement: DOJ funding guidance, named grant and scholarship compliance actions, university agreements, and the Thakur grant case expose bounded recipient conditions, reviews, programme terminations, suspensions, agreements, and affected research grants. They do not provide the complete grant and funding-recipient universe or all action, appeal, correction, and no-action rows.
included_rows: federal funding-recipient guidance and revocation risk
unavailable_rows: all conditions, certifications, reviews, withholdings, terminations, continuations, appeals, corrections, and no-action rows
complete award, amount, agency, recipient, programme, and timing denominator
refused_rows: named recipient actions are not treated as the complete funding universe
guidance is not treated as observed certification or enforcement
litigation classes are not treated as complete recipient rosters
negative_search_statement: The source set exposes bounded recipient rules and named actions but not the complete grant and funding-recipient action denominator.
correction_route: USAspending, agency grant, and recipient compliance records
award instruments, termination notices, and appeal files
administrative, judicial, inspector-general, congressional, and audit review

closure_target: funding substitution, programme continuity, recipient exit, public-value recovery, clawback, repayment, and unresolved-loss ledger
coverage_statement: PayPal, Minnesota, Illinois, UVA, Cornell, and Thakur expose bounded programme substitution, suspension, termination, settlement payment, alternative programme, research-grant continuity, and unresolved litigation rows. They do not form a complete substitution, exit, continuity, clawback, repayment, public-value recovery, and unresolved-loss ledger.
included_rows: replacement small-business initiative and settlement value
grant programme repeal and scholarship suspension
university payments, monitoring, eligibility, and replacement commitments
unavailable_rows: complete funding substitution and programme-continuity rows
recipient exit, replacement, clawback, repayment, recovery, loss, and no-recovery rows
complete public and private value allocation and performance ledger
refused_rows: announced settlement value is not treated as realized public recovery without payment and performance records
programme termination is not treated as successful substitution
one replacement programme is not treated as system-wide continuity
negative_search_statement: The official record exposes bounded substitution, termination, agreement, and payment structures but not the complete public-value recovery ledger.
correction_route: grant closeout, repayment, clawback, and audit records
programme replacement, recipient continuity, and performance reporting
